features.text: Leading companies and media outlets are talking about Wanderlog. Discover why we're their top choice for travel planning.
features.title: Features to replace all your other tools

features.text: Add the attractions you want to visit and see how to go between them on a map. Check distances and travel times between locations and attractions, schedule specific times for your visits, and optimize your route so you can make the most of your trip. See your flights and hotels for the day to keep track of what’s coming up.
features.title: Create a trip itinerary to see everything in one place

features.text: Get recommended the top places to visit and the best restaurants. Get ratings for top attractions, check their opening hours, and access links to official websites. We’ve gathered the top attractions from across the web in one place so you can see what are the consensus picks.
features.title: See top attractions and restaurants from the entire web

features.text: Create a detailed itinerary for your road trip. Add all your stops, check distances and time between each location. See lists of best stops on your route between cities. We optimize your route to save gas and ensure a smooth journey.
features.title: Plan road trips and hit the road

features.text: Keep track of your budget and split costs with your trip mates. View expense breakdowns. Use our preset packing lists or create your own. Customize to-do lists, shopping lists, and more to ensure you bring everything you need on your trip.
features.title: Pack and budget efficiently

features.text: Experience the full potential of Wanderlog with a Pro subscription. Enjoy enhanced features and streamlined planning.
features.title: Maximize your trip planning with Pro

hero_heading: One app for all your travel planning needs
hero_sub: Create detailed itineraries, explore user-shared guides, and manage your bookings seamlessly — all in one place.

blocks.text: Never switch tabs again. Compare results from trusted booking sites like Airbnb, Google, Expedia, Hotels.com, Booking.com, and more.
blocks.title: All-in-one hotel search

blocks.text: We monitor for when your hotel price drops, and notify you so you can re-book.
blocks.title: Never miss a price drop

blocks.text: Not just another hotel search — plan out your trip with us too! With features like real time collaboration, importing reservations, and  much more .
blocks.title: Plan your entire trip while you’re at it

hotels_copy.sub: Experience a better hotel search that helps you find the perfect lodging, with your preferences as the highest priority.
hotels_copy.title: Search for hotel and Airbnb stays in one place

testimonials.name: Josh M.
testimonials.text: I have used several trip planning apps. This one by far is the best. The interaction between goggle maps makes the planning so much easier. Adding an adventure not in the app is also easy. Love the connection to Trip Advisor also. Everything is connected including booking a stay. Easy to use on phone, tablets and computer! Well thought through development.

testimonials.name: Jack Corby
testimonials.text: The absolute best travel app I've ever tried. Complete and comprehensive planning made our 15 day trip to UK so easy. Tracks and catalogs attractions and sights, hotels, flights, restaurants and so much more complete with maps, trip costs and extras. Will definitely use this again! thanks for a great travel app! loved it!!

testimonials.name: Dennis Gruetter
testimonials.text: Super useful app to plan a trip and create a bucket list of places to visit

testimonials.name: Milton James
testimonials.text: A great app which we used for a road trip in Southern Italy. Even the free version let both of us access the itinerary, add information, download directions, etc. I loved the function which lets you link a confirmation email — so easy to find when you check in somewhere! The app also populates the itinerary with suggested attractions, restaurants, etc to visit, once you've added a place. There's a budgeting feature, and loads of other things we were constantly discovering. Highly recommended.

testimonials.name: Jenny La Fontaine
testimonials.text: This app is exceptional for trip planning. The AI feature, with a Map view allows you to visualize the attraction locations - the optimization feature provides a quick way to plan the day(s). Finally, a more holistic planning tool that incorporates Itinerary, booking details, budgeting, search and checklists - Wanderlog has incorporated a ton into this inexpensive app. I have provided some ideas to their team and their responsiveness is exceptional. Love it!

testimonials.name: Lydia Yang
testimonials.text: Best app, out of all the travel apps I tried. Settled on Wanderlog and was not disappointed.

testimonials.name: Reyna Wilcox
testimonials.text: I absolutely love this app!!! I would recommend to anyone who is seriously planning a trip. It will take you through there entire process with ease and all the features you would ever need. The pro version has some features that would be nice to have, especially during the trip itself, but none of it is absolutely necessary. My only criticism is of the pro payment options. You can only buy an annual subscription, and no monthly options exist. Even a 3 month/semi annual sub would be nice.

testimonials.name: Christina Cejas
testimonials.text: Used this app to plan a road trip, two days to and two days back home. It was simple and easy to organize. It allowed two cars to coordinate a path so we always knew where we were going. Every place we visited was a hit. Road trips can be tiring but this app made it less painful and a lot more fun.

testimonials.name: Jane Turner
testimonials.text: The best app so far for travel planning. Has some lags, sometimes the import of packages that includes lodging and plane tickets get counted twice in the budget. The pay option is mostly for AI and automation, it is very well placed and affordable, so paying for it is a good option but not mandatory for regular use. When looking at the budget it would be good to have the option to convert all different currency into one to have a real view of were money is spent.

testimonials.name: Jorge D.
testimonials.text: This travel app is amazing! Loved how the creators have taught about every bit of travel. It has a packing list as well. I did all this with the basic app and not the pro app. Will use it for every trip!

testimonials.name: Dasha S.
testimonials.text: I’ve been dreaming of a tool like this for years and finally it’s here! Wanderlog is my new go-to tool after decades of professional travel.

testimonials.name: Ioanna C
testimonials.text: I'm really enjoying this app for my road trip. It shows me more info than Tripadvisor though sometimes it's hard to search smaller towns and activities.

title: Wanderlog travel planner: free vacation planner and itinerary app
